title: Ephemeral SLI proxy for isolating noisy analytics queries
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Problem: High-cardinality noisy queries from a small set of tenants are skewing pipeline SLIs and triggering noisy alerts. The analytics ingest path and query servicing layers currently compute global SLIs that do not isolate the noise, making it hard to detect real degradations for other tenants.

Goal: Introduce an ephemeral SLI proxy layer that can be deployed per-ingest-route to (1) shadow and mirror query traffic, (2) compute tenant- and route-scoped SLIs in isolation, and (3) apply adaptive alert thresholds and temporary throttles for noisy sources without impacting overall pipeline SLAs. The proxy should be lightweight, attachable to existing instrumented endpoints, and compatible with our tracing headers and sampling strategy.

Scope: Prototype a sidecar-style proxy for the analytics ingestion API and the streaming aggregator service. Deliverables: design doc, prototype binary, integration tests that validate SLI separation, dashboards for per-proxy metrics, and a runbook for enabling/disabling proxies in production.

Non-goals: This ticket does not implement tenant billing changes or permanent rate-limiting policies; it is focused on observability isolation and short-term mitigation (ephemeral throttles, synthetic SLI windows).
updates: 2026-02-28: Kickoff meeting with infra, telemetry, and platform teams. Agreed on sidecar pattern for minimal surface area changes and re-use of existing sampling headers (x-trace-id, x-sampling-priority).

2026-03-02: Prototype completed — small Go binary that attaches as HTTP/GRPC proxy and emits route-scoped metrics (ingest.latency_ms, ingest.kv_cache_hits, ingest.error_rate) tagged by tenant_id and proxy_id. Key trade-off: we only mirror a 10% sample of traffic by default to control cost.

2026-03-03: Design review with SRE and Product. SRE requested automatic backoff when proxy CPU > 60% to avoid contention. Product wants a dashboard tile that compares global SLI vs proxy-isolated SLI for triage.
2026-03-04: Integration tests added — end-to-end trace context propagation verified across proxy -> aggregator -> storage (trace IDs preserved). Found minor header mutation bug; fixed in PR.
2026-03-05: Preparing canary plan and runbook; flagged dependency on per-tenant sampling config (ENG-61234) to be completed before wide rollout.
comments: Aisha Patel (2026-03-01): Prototype looks promising. Need to confirm ingestion QPS overhead at 100% mirror vs 10% sample. Let's keep default at 10% and provide a knob per-route.

SRE (Marta Liu) (2026-03-02): Concerned about increased cardinality in metrics backend. Recommend emitting aggregated 1s histograms and using labels: tenant_shard instead of full tenant_id for heavy tenants.
Dev (Diego Martinez) (2026-03-03): Implemented proxy health endpoint and /debug/pprof. Will add a runtime flag for aggressive aggregation to reduce cardinality when the backend reports index blowups.
PM (Rafael Gomez) (2026-03-04): Can we surface a per-tenant 'noise score' in the Console so CS can contact customers before we throttle them? Add as future enhancement if prototype proves stable.
Security (Nina Verma) (2026-03-05): Confirmed headers are forwarded but no auth tokens are logged. Please ensure proxy never logs full request bodies for PII-sensitive routes.
